Definition: Eber, the name of two patriarchs and four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eber or Heber = "the region beyond"; 1) son of Salah, great grandson of Shem, father of Peleg and Joktan; 2) a Gadite chief; 3) a Benjamite, son of Elpaal and descendant of Sharahaim; 4) a Benjamite, son of Shashak; 5) a priest in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua
